item.title: Trump warns Australia 'is making a terrible humanitarian mistake' over Iranian women's soccer team
item.summary: President Donald Trump offered a stark warning to Australia as the Iranian women's soccer team was set to return to their country after falling out of the Women's Asian Cup.

item.title: Social media erupts on Mamdani over reports his wife liked pro-October 7th posts: 'This is who they are'
item.summary: New York City mayor Zohran Mamdani faces intense backlash after reports his wife allegedly liked social media posts about October 7 Hamas attack on Israel.

item.title: Congress weighs new funding for Trump's Iran strikes as war costs rise and Democrats cry foul
item.summary: GOP leaders signal they may seek additional funding for President Donald Trump’s military operation in Iran, with lawmakers warning the price tag could be “very robust."

item.title: RFK Jr calls out popular chains over high-sugar coffee drinks: What's really in your cup?
item.summary: Robert F. Kennedy Jr. is challenging Starbucks and Dunkin' over the sugar content in popular frozen coffee drinks, with medical experts sharing health warnings.

item.title: Schumer once blocked Trump's move to fill the nation's oil reserves, now he wants them opened
item.summary: Senate Minority Leader Chuck Schumer, D-N.Y., wants President Donald Trump to tap into the nation's oil reserves, which were heavily drawn down under former President Joe Biden.

item.title: GOP-led counties push back against Democrats' redistricting charge, testing Virginia’s constitutional limits
item.summary: Virginia counties mount legal resistance to April redistricting vote that could reshape congressional districts, citing constitutional violations.

item.title: Dolphins appear to find Tua Tagovailoa's replacement as free agency opens
item.summary: The Miami Dolphins reportedly agreed to a deal with quarterback Malik Willis on Monday hours after announcing they would part ways with Tua Tagovailoa.

item.summary: House Republicans demand answers on alleged Chinese birth tourism in Pacific territory, raising national security concerns over citizenship loopholes.

item.title: Chiefs, Super Bowl MVP Kenneth Walker III agree to deal as NFL free agency begins: reports
item.summary: The Kansas City Chiefs and running back Kenneth Walker III agreed to a deal on Monday, according to multiple reports, as NFL free agency opened up.

item.title: Southwest flight diverted after passenger scare as security incidents rattle US airports
item.summary: Multiple airline security scares disrupted weekend travel across several airports, though authorities found no credible threats in any incidents.
